create_fixed_backbone_program: create a ProgramNode for protein design with a fixed backbone template using PDB 6mrs
build_protein_optimization_node: build a ProgramNode with PTM, pLDDT maximization and RMSD minimization energy terms
fetch_pdb_template_atoms: fetch a PDB structure from RCSB and convert it to an AtomArray for template use
extract_sequence_from_template: extract the amino acid sequence from a PDB template AtomArray to determine sequence length
review_fixed_backbone_6mrs: review the fixed_backbone_6mrs function that configures energy terms for fixed backbone protein design
